adminSettings.maxmindHint: Powers the country map on the dashboard. Get a free key at maxmind.com/en/geolite2/signup.
adminSettings.trustProxyDescription: Reverse proxies in front of this server (Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy, Cloudflare…) that may report each visitor's real IP. Without this, the dashboard, login limits and IP bans see the proxy's IP for everyone. Only list proxies you control.
adminSettings.trustProxyHint: Comma-separated: uniquelocal (private and Docker networks), cloudflare, linklocal, or IPs/CIDRs. Leave empty if nothing sits in front of the container.
adminSettings.trustProxyYourIp: The server currently sees your IP as {ip}.
adminSettings.servicesHint: Live status, and a way to restart either part of the app without touching the host.
adminSettings.languageHint: The language of the login screen and of new accounts. Signed-in users can still pick their own.
adminSettings.sessionTtlDescription: How long a signed-in session stays valid before it must sign in again, regardless of activity.
adminSettings.loginRateLimitMaxDescripti: Maximum login attempts allowed per IP and per account within the window before further attempts are blocked.
adminSettings.loginRateLimitWindowDescri: The time window the login attempt limit resets every.
adminSettings.cookieSecureDescription: Marks the session cookie HTTPS-only. Enable only when serving over HTTPS — otherwise the cookie is never returned and no one can stay signed in.
adminSettings.maxmindDescription: Without a key the country map on the dashboard just shows no dots — nothing else is affected.
adminSettings.languageDescription: Applies to the login page and to accounts created from now on.
adminSettings.appNameDescription: Shown in the navigation bar, in on-screen text and in every email.
adminSettings.backendDescription: The Node.js process that serves the API and talks to the database.
adminSettings.frontendDescription: The nginx process that serves the web app and proxies API requests to the backend.
ipAccess.rateLimitedHint: IPs currently locked out after too many login attempts or receipt uploads. They clear on their own, or you can unblock one now.
ipAccess.bannedHint: Blocked from the entire server until you remove them — this doesn't expire on its own.

adminSettings.generalHint: Names shown across the app and in emails. Saved right away, no restart needed.
adminSettings.appUrlDescription: The address people use to open PixlBank. Emails link here; leave empty to send them without a link.
adminSettings.emailHint: Used for payment reminders, receipt results for debtors, and alerts to you when a receipt fails or needs a review.
adminSettings.smtpSecureDescription: Direct TLS (usually port 465). Leave off for STARTTLS on port 587.
adminSettings.smtpFromDescription: Sender shown to recipients, e.g. PixlBank <bank@example.com>. Defaults to the username.
adminSettings.remindersEnabled: Email debtors before a payment is due, on the due date, and once when it becomes overdue
adminSettings.reminderDaysBeforeDescript: When to send the "payment coming up" email. 0 turns that one off.
adminSettings.reminderHourDescription: Reminders go out once a day, from this hour in the server's timezone (TZ in .env).
adminSettings.testEmailPlaceholder: Your own address if left empty
adminSettings.saveFirst: Save a working SMTP configuration first.
adminSettings.ollamaHint: A multimodal model (such as gemma3) reads the amount and date off every receipt a debtor uploads and gives it a 0-100% confidence score. A receipt that is too old or whose amount doesn't match gets a low (red) score. It never approves or rejects — you always decide.
adminSettings.ollamaUrlDescription: Address of your Ollama server, reachable from the container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434 or http://host.docker.internal:11434.
adminSettings.ollamaModelDescription: A vision-capable model already pulled on that server, e.g. gemma3:12b or gemma3:4b.
adminSettings.ollamaModelMissing: That model isn't on the server yet — run `ollama pull` for it.
adminSettings.ollamaTimeoutDescription: How long to wait for the model. If it takes longer, the payment shows "AI failed" and you can analyze it again.
adminSettings.receiptMaxAgeDescription: Receipts dated earlier than this many days ago get a low score.
adminSettings.receiptToleranceDescriptio: How far the amount read from the receipt may differ from the one the debtor entered.
adminSettings.receiptRateLimitMaxDescrip: Maximum payment receipts one IP may submit within the window. Each one runs the vision model.
adminSettings.receiptRateLimitWindowDesc: The time window the receipt limit resets every.
